newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Pakhoed to reorganise Dutch storage unit.
newsitem.headline: Pakhoed to reorganise Dutch storage unit.

text.p: Dutch tank storage and shipping group Koninklijke Pakhoed NV said on Wednesday it would restructure its unit Paktank Oil Nederland BV because of disappointing results in the Dutch tank storage market.
The reorganisation includes the number of jobs in operational and staff departments to be cut by 75 to about 300.
"The costs of this restructuring have already been recognised by Royal Pakhoed as extraordinary charges in the first half of 1996," the company said in a statement.
